## Synopsis

strazad dials the address the draft names, follows no redirect, starts nothing, and keeps the
tool names on the draft so its check reads them. The names and descriptions are the server's
own text.

```
strazactl drafts contact <id> <server> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --json   print the server's JSON answer, indented, and nothing else on stdout
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
